summary: A local paper describes a historic fire tower in Reidsville, possibly built in the late 1930s, that was moved a third time to a new home on Old River Road. Not confirmed as the tnlandforms list entry.

facts.status_note: According to a local newspaper, the Reidsville fire tower was dismantled and moved to a new site on Old River Road. Not confirmed as the tnlandforms list entry.

notes_for_editor: The Journal article carries no date in the copy we could read, so the move is dated only as 'the third time'. Its cached text stops mid-sentence ('just west of the Tattnall'), so the new site's name and the tower's current use are not confirmed. A search summary (not a page we read) also described a Highway 147 site, a 1950s move and a Heart of Dixie Outdoors observation tower; these are unverified and kept out of the story. The tnlandforms entry is named for the town, so it is probably this tower, but the list does not say so. The record point (32.08314, -82.11401) is near the town centre, while the article puts the tower on the western outskirts, so the point may not be the original site. Status changed from unknown to relocated in facts; no built or move year is given, so no events are listed.
